title: adidas-Salomon AG - proposed acquisition of Reebok International Ltd

body_sections.Summary: adidas-Salomon AG is the second largest sporting goods company in the world. In Australia, adidas supplies footwear and apparel and golf-related goods through its brand TaylorMade. Reebok International Ltd is a worldwide designer, marketer and distributor of sporting and related products. Like adidas, Reebok supplies footwear and apparel as well as a range of fitness equipment in Australia.
body_sections.Market definition: For the purposes of a competition assessment in Australia, the ACCC considered the impact of the acquisition on the national markets for athletic footwear and apparel.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC formed the view that the proposed acquisition is not likely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in the relevant markets. In making its decision, the ACCC considered that the merged entity was likely to continue to be constrained by the existence of a number of large competitors, significant import competition, relatively low barriers to entry and a number of retailers who are likely to be able to exercise countervailing power.
